measures.title: DeKalb County ESPLOST
measures.summary: Reimposes the existing 1 percent sales and use tax for education in DeKalb County when the current tax expires, starting July 1, 2027, for up to 20 calendar quarters, to raise up to $1,046,154,324. Up to $946,773,776 goes to the DeKalb County School District, up to $41,504,193 to Atlanta Public Schools and up to $57,876,355 to City Schools of Decatur, for new and renovated schools and facilities, technology and safety improvements, equipment, and buses and vehicles. If voters within the DeKalb County School District approve, the vote also authorizes that district to issue up to $500,000,000 in general obligation debt for part of its projects.
measures.yesMeans: The 1 percent education sales tax continues for up to five more years, and the DeKalb County School District may issue up to $500 million in bonds if its voters approve.
measures.noMeans: The education sales tax is not reimposed when the current tax expires, and the bonds are not authorized.

measures.id: City of Brookhaven Homestead Exemption for Senior Citizens and Disabled Persons
measures.title: Homestead Exemption for Senior Citizens and Disabled Persons (House Bill 1307, Act No. 555)
measures.summary: Asks whether the Act incorporating the City of Brookhaven should be amended to increase the city homestead exemption for senior citizens and disabled persons from $160,000 to $200,000.
measures.yesMeans: The city homestead exemption for qualifying senior citizens and disabled persons increases from $160,000 to $200,000.
